body.message:
Good morning,

I hope you are doing well.

I sincerely apologize for this message. I have been waiting for funds to arrive in my account, which were expected today. Unfortunately, due to a holiday in my home country, the transfer is taking longer than expected.

I wanted to kindly ask if it would be possible to extend the payment until the end of this week. I would also be happy to make a partial payment of 1,000 AED as a sign of commitment and pay the remaining balance as soon as the funds arrive.

Thank you for your understanding and patience.
